content: This tour uses a sample form space to show the form and where drafts and submitted copies go. The example is separate from your own spaces.

comment.text: Body of the Forms onboarding tour step that highlights the sample form space (or the sample form and folders inside it) used for the tour; tells the user it is an example, not their own space. Drafts go to In progress, submitted copies to Complete.
